# SphinxAI

> Human-like AI voice agents for clinics, real estate, customer service, and sales teams in Egypt and MENA. Answer calls, qualify leads, and book appointments 24/7 in Arabic and English.

- [Packages](/packages): Sphinx Lite, Pro, and Elite plans.
- [Presentation](/presentation): Interactive sales presentation for clinics and hospitals.

- [Contact](/contact): Book a demo.
